drhp.business: Sunshield Chemicals, established in 1986, manufactures specially formulated and customised chemicals for a wide range of industrial applications. Its products include ethylene-oxide-based specialty surfactants (ethoxylates and propoxylates), specialty antioxidants, THEIC, HQEE, urea formaldehyde resin and miscellaneous products. It is among the few global manufacturers of THEIC and HQEE and states it is the only Indian manufacturer of THEIC. It serves customers in India and in North America, South America, Europe, South-East Asia, the Far East and the Middle East. Installed capacity in FY2024 was about 18,076 tonnes, including 7,740 tonnes of ethoxylates and propoxylates, 2,200 tonnes of antioxidants, 5,640 tonnes of THEIC, 480 tonnes of HQEE and 336 tonnes of urea formaldehyde resin. Ownership of the company passed from Solvay to Indus Petrochem.
